description:
At the NSLSI-II, the DSSI (Data Science and Systems Integration) Division is responsible for the computing infrastructure, data collection and analysis tools, various beamline controls systems, and much more. DSSI works together with staff across the facility to help enable accelerator operations, beamline experiments, and user data analysis. DSSI is an exciting place to work and use technology to contribute to the amazing scientific discovery taking place throughout the facility.
  
 Position Description 
 The Data Engineering Group within the NSLS-II’s Data Science and Systems Integration Division is seeking a student assistant to join the team as a software engineer. A successful candidate for this position is an engaged and motivated student who is excited to collaborate with a broad range of scientists and engineers. Potential projects and tasks include work on central data infrastructure, such as the open-source data access service Tiled, as well as beamline-specific data systems. We seek those who are interested in managing large, complex collections of data, especially to support scientific discovery.
   
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Develop and maintain software which makes up part of the facility’s data infrastructure
 Perform limited operations support for software or infrastructure under development
 Collaborate with other engineers and scientists to gather and address requirements
 Configure infrastructure (such as databases, containers, system monitors) and deploy changes using IaC (infrastructure as code)
 
 Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 
 Currently enrolled in an academic program leading to a bachelor’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, information technology, or a related field
 A demonstrated passion for collaborative software development
 Experience developing software in Python, especially web servers or storage utilities
 Experience working in a Linux environment, including command line and basic system management
 Knowledge of file systems, databases, SQL, and authentication & authorization concepts is a plus
 
 Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 
 Senior standing or equivalent placement in an academic program in one of the prescribed fields
 Existing contributions to open-source software projects or other scientific software
 Experience working with FastAPI and related libraries.
 Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills. Ability to work well in a team environment, with people who have a range of interests and abilities.
 
 Other Information: 
 This position is primarily on-site, with limited hybrid allowed for some situations (such as remote meetings)
   

 Brookhaven Laboratory is committed to providing fair, equitable and competitive compensation. The full salary range for this position is $17.00 - $31.25 / hourly. Salary offers will be commensurate with the final candidate’s qualification, education and experience and considered with the internal peer group.

 Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to employee success and we believe that a comprehensive employee benefits program is an important and meaningful part of the compensation employees receive. Review more information at BNL | Benefits Program 

 Brookhaven National Laboratory requires all non-badged personnel including visitors to produce a REAL-ID or REAL-ID compliant documentation to access Brookhaven National Laboratory – view more information at  www.bnl.gov/real-id .  This is due to nationwide identification requirements for federal site access as required by the federal  REAL ID Act .   Those not in possession of a REAL ID-compliant document will not be permitted to access the site which includes access to the Laboratory for interviews . 

 As a U.S. Department of Energy laboratory, Brookhaven National Laboratory requires employees to obtain and maintain a DOE Uncleared Personal Identity Verification (UPIV) credential in accordance with Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) requirements. The credentialing process is completed as part of onboarding and enables access to DOE facilities and information systems. As a condition of employment, the selected candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a UPIV credential. These requirements are established under DOE Order 206.2 Chg. 2, Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM- Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) ) , and DOE Order 473.1A- Physical Protection Program- Physical Protection Program .

 About Us 
 Brookhaven National Laboratory (www.bnl.gov) delivers discovery science and transformative technology to power and secure the nation’s future. Brookhaven Lab is a multidisciplinary laboratory with seven Nobel Prize-winning discoveries, 37 R&D 100 Awards, and more than 70 years of pioneering research. The Lab is primarily supported by the U.S. Department of Energy’s (DOE) Office of Science. Brookhaven Science Associates (BSA) operates and manages the Laboratory for DOE. BSA is a partnership between Battelle and The Research Foundation for the State University of New York on behalf of Stony Brook University. BSA salutes our veterans and active military members with careers that leverage the skills and unique experience they gained while serving our country, learn more at BNL | Opportunities for Veterans at Brookhaven National Laboratory .
